messages:
maya: Quick async follow-up from the postmortem on the KV-cache OOM. Goal: agree owners + minimal validation steps so SRE can gate the canary.

frank: I captured heap-diffs and a short pprof. Primary signal is growing fragmentation in small-object arena. link: https://redwood/s/INC-2122/heapdiffs.zip

anya: Proposed short list: profiling, conservative GC bump, soft cap + eviction tweak, compactor opt-in, and canary gate. assignable in ~24-48h.

maya: Compact action list (owners/due):
- P1 Profiling & flamegraphs (owner: anya) \u2014 run staging replay, attach pprof to INC-2122. due: 2026-03-26
- P2 GC tuning experiment (owner: frank) \u2014 test GOGC=200 / runtime.gc.percent=200 and measure heaplive/pause. PR + canary. due: 2026-03-27
- P3 Soft cap + reject policy (owner: leo) \u2014 add kv.cache.soft_limit_pct and `soft_reject` behavior exposed via metric `kv_soft_rejects`. draft PR. due: 2026-03-28
- P4 Background compactor (owner: frank) \u2014 opt-in compaction job every 4h; metric `kv_compactions`. due: 2026-03-29
- P5 Canary plan & SRE gates (owner: maya) \u2014 canary 5% with rollback on error_rate>0.6% or kv_fragmentation>0.75. due: 2026-03-26

frank: quick commands i used:```GODEBUG=gctrace=1 ./server --replay=staging
pprof --pdf server.cpu > /tmp/server.pdf
```

leo: config snippet for soft cap:```kv.cache.max_entries=50M
kv.cache.soft_limit_pct=80
kv.cache.soft_reject_behavior=evict_oldest```
I'll open PR INF-3529-PR1 and add README with validation steps.

anya: i'll run the profiling tonight and post flamegraphs. initial hunch: short-lived allocations from dedupe/transform workers are the main contributor.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-softcap by @leo at 1865020120 \u2014 route 5% | sha: c3a9f0b

maya: SRE notes: please include p99 latency and CPU burn in the canary dashboard. SRE will pause expansion if either p99 increases by +60ms or error_rate > 0.5%.

leo: PR opened: https://redwood/pull/INF-3529-PR1 (soft cap + metrics). README added.

infra-bot: alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio crossed 0.76 on prod-1 at 1865020245 \u2014 paging SRE.

maya: halting canary expansion; SRE please verify and decide rollback.

frank: compactor draft posted: https://redwood/pull/INF-3530-draft (opt-in). compaction reduced fragmentation ~10% in last bench.

anya: flamegraphs uploaded to INC-2122/artifacts. will follow up with suggested object reuse patterns for dedupe.

leo: rolling canary back to 0% until SRE thumbs up.

infra-bot: deploy updated: canary-kv-softcap route 0% at 1865020280 by @leo

maya: I'll update the postmortem follow-up sheet with these items and owners, schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review canary telemetry. If anyone reassigns, ping me. Thanks.

frank: noted, will iterate on GC tuning measurements.

anya: thanks team, will post results by EOD.
